title: Tune In Hoodie
description:
Oh believe me, they’ll try.

This cheeky Cheshire cat tshirt is for anyone who refuses to be derailed! Grin through the chaos and give those haters absolutely nothing to work with...because they really do hate to see us smilin’ and shinin’.

title: Nature vs Machine Diptych
description:
**A diptych that collapses the boundaries between natural and artificial systems.**

This pair of **A3 posters** questions "nature versus machine," with each image containing characteristics we usually associate with the other.

Bright, graphic and just a little bit uncanny, the pairing sits comfortably in the ambiguous, holding the tension between opposites.

title: Manifesto Zine
description:
An A5 zine all about the creative process, framed through a transformative, alchemical cycle.

This isn't your average self-help guide. It's your field notes for moving an idea from an intuitive notion into actualized form.

The five stages **Unveil, Articulate, Synthesize, Actualise and Distill** give the creative process a symbolic structure to follow, but the writing stays grounded in practice with affirming honesty that will help you to bring your brilliant ideas into reality.

title: Polycephalic Postcard (Double Sided)
description:
**Four postcards for the price of one!**

Not only are there multiple ways to view each face, there's a different design printed on either side.

Display one then, flip it, turn it, reverse it as you please. If you're the kind of person who gets bored easily, this artwork should definitely keep you entertained for a while.

title: Match My Freak! Badges
description: Get one for you, one for your bestie. Match your freak.

title: Grumpy Green Man Sticker
description:
*With the state of things, no wonder he's grumpy.*

A super-shiny **holographic sticker featuring this very cute Green Man** — a bit fed up with the world, but still sparkling! Approx. **3 inches tall x 2.4 inches wide**.
